chunks: And the woman who has despaired of menstruation.

key_terms.يَئِسَتْ: has despaired or ceased to expect

ai.seo_question: What does Shia hadith say about a woman who has despaired of menstruation in divorce rulings?
ai.summary: This report refers to the woman who has reached menopause and no longer expects menstruation. In the jurisprudential context of divorce rulings, it identifies a specific legal category among women.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "And the woman who has despaired of menstruation (menopause)."
